brief: Team retreat in Berlin for 14 people, 2 nights from 2027-03-10. Somewhere quiet and inspiring where we can also sleep. Budget EUR 9,000.

turns.text: Top candidates: Kastanie, Hofgarten, Lindenufer (Berlin), Seeblick.

input.summary: Three quiet, policy-compliant venues can host 14 people for 2 nights from 2027-03-10, all within the EUR 9,000 budget. Villa Kastanie is a preferred vendor and the best fit for "quiet and inspiring". Prices are for single rooms and no breakout rooms, as none were requested.

offers.tradeOff: Quiet villa with library and garden, preferred vendor, 30 minutes from Berlin; it costs more than Hofgarten and is in the city, not a remote setting.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest option with a creative courtyard and quiet garden; it is in central Kreuzberg, so less secluded.

rfp.subject: Team retreat request: 14 guests, 2 nights from 2027-03-10
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are planning a quiet team retreat and would like a proposal.

Arrival: 2027-03-10 (alternatives 2027-03-17 or 2027-03-24), 2 nights.
Guests: 14, each in a single room (28 room nights).
Meeting space: one meeting room for the full group, with lunch and coffee on both days. No breakout rooms needed.
Dietary needs: none reported. Please confirm vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options.
Accessibility: no wheelchair users.
Budget: all-in total up to EUR 9,000.

Please include a price breakdown and reply by 2026-11-06.

Thank you,
Demo Co.
